verdict.rationale: Netlify is an edge/serverless hosting platform, so handling WebSocket connections in its functions is a fair question to ask. The pack shows serverless functions ('Build APIs with serverless functions') and mentions edge functions, but nothing documents WebSocket support or persistent connections from those functions. The 'real-time' mention refers to collaborative content previews, not WebSockets.

support.subject: As a developer, I can handle persistent WebSocket connections from within edge/serverless functions for real-time apps
